Text: R1.6 on a real desktop: from Search, use Edit / Archive / Delete / Manage services on one client and confirm each acts on the client that was clicked (offscreen, open_client_editor leaves the table selection empty after setCurrentCell, so Manage services may report 'Select one or more clients first.')

R6.3 on a real PC: open Search, Manage Clients, Tracker Dump, Audit, Settings and Sera Sync at 100 %, 125 % and 150 % Windows scaling and at 1366x768; nothing clipped, no horizontal scroll, text readable

Real keyboard on a real desktop: press Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 (alert appears, restart applies the scale), Alt+n and Alt+Ctrl+n on a search result, Ctrl+B, F5 in Tracker Dump, and Tab order through the Manage Clients form; offscreen tests call the handlers/shortcuts directly
On a real desktop: hover a DataGrid row and its drawn action buttons (hover fill, tooltip per button, click runs the action); drag a column edge and confirm the width survives a window resize
On a real 125% display, open a SlidePanel in a window narrower than 1080 px: it should fill the width with no left edge, and a DialogFrame (normal and full) should show no clipped title or footer.
On a real Windows screen at 100 % and 125 %, compare Mockups/built/kit/*.png lettering and sizes with Mockups/fleet/index.html Foundation page (headless browser render was not allowed in the worker)

On a real 125 % screen at 1366x768 and 1024x700: open Sidebar Display and Settings General Screen scale, check Apply and Restart now fit, then Restart now really restarts Sera and the new scale applies.

Sidebar on a real 1366x768 laptop at Windows 125 % and Sera display scale 1.00 / 1.25: brand, All Clients + Ctrl K hint, Auto-sync pill not clipped; Ctrl+B, Ctrl+=, Ctrl+-, Ctrl+0 pressed on a real keyboard (offscreen only tests the wiring).
On a real 125 % screen, open Settings > General and check nothing clips: nav, five cards, unsaved bar, footer Save.
Edit one General setting then press Close or Esc: confirm the wording of the 'Unsaved changes' prompt (Save changes / Discard changes / Keep editing) is what you want.
Real-desktop 125% check: open Settings > Tracker, Backup and Purge on a real 125% laptop and confirm nothing clips.
Tracker PageHeader lead elides at 1024 px ('...beside S...'); confirm the wording is acceptable or shorten the lead.
On a real 1366x768 screen, open Settings > Backup and confirm the Danger zone is readable and Restore is clearly red.

Settings > Master Column List on a real screen: click the M/Q/A ticks with the mouse, Alt+Up/Alt+Down on a selected row, Add/Edit/Delete column with a real column editor dialog, and check that the visibility pages agree before Save.
On a real 125% screen, open Settings > Services and the Service edit and Column edit dialogs: check nothing clips and the dropdown lists open fully.
On a real 125 % display, open All Clients: no horizontal scrollbar, chips and header not clipped, Columns menu fits.
SearchWindow.columns_changed is not connected in main.py: toggle a column in Columns on All Clients while Settings is open and confirm whether Settings needs to refresh.

All Clients selection bar on a real screen at 125 %: select one row, several rows, then cells; bar never jumps, Fill/Text swatches match the cell, Delete asks and Cancel keeps the client. Also delete the two stray test-temp folders 'UsersNexAppDataLocalTemp...scratchpadpt1' and '...pt2' in the APP-ui root (left by an earlier run; not committed)
Real 125 % screen: open a client in the detail panel and check the Services, Identity and Logins rows fit; the Notes and collapsed Portal values sections are not in the goldens.
Real clipboard: copy a password, then confirm the clipboard is cleared after 30 s.
Two-PC checks: Alt+1..9 autofill and Alt+Ctrl+1..9 on a real browser, with the detail panel open.
Visual check of the collapsed Portal values card: header row, Show toggle and expanded rows on a real screen.
Look at Manage Clients on a real screen: the factory form fields (plain Qt inputs from the global QSS) next to the kit cards, light and dark.

At 1366 the bulk bar buttons are icon-only: confirm the tooltips make Attach/detach, Archive, Restore and Delete permanently clear. Also check the soft New client button, the 'Unsaved changes' line (editor header grows by one line), and that all five filter chips fit the 390 px list column at 125 %.
Open Tracker Dump on a real 125 percent screen with a real client list (1024 px wide): Client column is narrow there because fit_columns is unchanged; confirm names are still readable enough
